title: CATS: code and data for client-side tail scheduling of multi-network HTTP downloads
description: Simulator, real-TCP testbed, real-network harness, raw results and analysis scripts behind the manuscript "Splitting Instead of Copying: Client-Side Tail Scheduling for Multi-Network HTTP Downloads". The addresses of the server and the client are withheld.
